title: inventory/hosts.yml
description: An env's hosts and their roles. jarvis validate also checks one control_plane and one backup host, and at least one edge host.

node_roles.description: The host's roles. Across hosts: exactly one control_plane, exactly one backup, at least one edge. A host may hold several, and no role implies another.

data_disk.description: true when a filesystem of its own is mounted at /var/lib/jarvis; omit it otherwise. node-disk checks the mount before any change.

ssh_user.description: The user Ansible logs in to this host as, in place of the env's ssh_user.

k3s_kubelet_kube_reserved.description: This host's kubelet kube-reserved, in place of the env's.

k3s_kubelet_system_reserved.description: This host's kubelet system-reserved, in place of the env's.

k3s_kubelet_eviction_hard.description: This host's kubelet eviction-hard, in place of the env's. The env's node memory reserve still applies.
